Interested in getting an iPhone Duo before Christmas? You might be in luck, as Apple’s online store delivery estimates just got pulled forward by a full month, with December delivery now expected.

Apple seems to be finding success in ramping up its iPhone Duo production.

Within minutes of iPhone Duo pre-orders opening on October 16, delivery estimates quickly slipped into November, then December, and after about a half hour of orders, the earliest you could get an iPhone Duo was late January.

The second beta follows the first developer release on November 3 and first public beta on November 5.

One of the biggest changes introduced in iOS 27.3 so far is the redesigned Health app, which briefly appeared during iOS 27.2 testing before being removed ahead of release.

articles.title: iOS 27.3 adds new face unlock feature for iPhone Duo
articles.summary: In today’s iOS 27.3 beta release, Apple is introducing two changes for iPhone Duo users. Most notably, it adds a new face recognition option that lets you unlock your iPhone Duo by looking at it. Apple is also adding an option to have your iPhone Duo lock when you close it. more…
articles.excerpt:
In today’s iOS 27.3 beta release, Apple is introducing two changes for iPhone Duo users. Most notably, it adds a new face recognition option that lets you unlock your iPhone Duo by looking at it.

Apple is also adding an option to have your iPhone Duo lock when you close it.

You can enable the new option to unlock your iPhone Duo with the front camera in Settings, under Touch ID & Passcode, after updating to iOS 27.3. When enabled, your iPhone Duo will unlock after recognizing your face.

Most notably, the buttons for search and for adding a new event have both been moved from the top of the screen to the bottom.
